question: **Identify the correctly spelt sentence. **

options.text: Human personality is classifide into three types- introvert, extrovert and ambivert.
Human persunality is clasified into three types- introvert, extrovert and ambivert.
Human personality is classified into three types- introvert, extrovert and ambivert.
Human personality is classfied into three types- introvert, extrovert and ambivert

solution:
The correct answer is: **Human personality is classified into three types- introvert, extrovert and ambivert.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Personality **is spelt correctly in this sentence, it refers to the unique set of characteristics, traits, behaviours, and patterns of thought that define an individual. (विशेषताओं, लक्षण, व्यवहार और विचार के पैटर्न का अनूठा सेट जो किसी व्यक्ति को परिभाषित करता है)
 
• **Classified **is also spelt correctly here, it has several meanings, but in the context of the sentence provided, it is used as a verb. When something is classified, it means it is categorized or organized based on certain criteria. (कुछ मानदंडों के आधार पर वर्गीकृत या संगठित)
 
• **Introvert**: A person who tends to be more reserved, reflective, and focused inwardly. (एक व्यक्ति जो अधिक आरक्षित, चिंतनशील और आंतरिक रूप से केंद्रित होता है)
 
• **Extrovert**: A person who is outgoing, sociable, and energized by being around others. (एक ऐसा व्यक्ति जो मिलनसार, मिलनसार और दूसरों के बीच रहकर ऊर्जावान होता है)
 
• **Ambivert**: A person who falls somewhere in between introversion and extroversion, displaying characteristics of both personality types. (एक व्यक्ति जो अंतर्मुखता और बहिर्मुखता के बीच में पड़ता है, दोनों प्रकार के व्यक्तित्व की विशेषताओं को प्रदर्शित करता है)

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.
